results.description: ssh_exec propagates a non-zero remote exit code without throwing

results.description: ssh_exec applies cwd and env, including single quotes and spaces

results.description: ssh_exec honours stdin and pty (-tt)

results.description: ssh_exec timeout: timedOut=true, returns promptly, local child killed
results.notes: timedOut after 1506ms (wall 1507ms); remote pid(s) still alive at that point: "263060"

results.description: OBSERVATION: killing the local ssh child does NOT stop the remote command
results.notes: remote command kept running and created its marker ~3s after the 1s timeout killed the client (documented in REPORT.md as a limitation of client-side cancellation)

results.description: output is capped at maxOutputBytes and flagged truncated
results.notes: stdout=4096B (cap 4096), truncated=true

results.description: ssh_upload then ssh_download returns byte-identical content

results.notes: recursive tree round trip ok
